34:t_022:2.en:
$$リツコ$$
「It can't be... An Angel devouring an EVA... That's impossible!」

34:t_022:3.en:
$$マヤ$$
「Something's wrong! The Angel's identification signal is switching over to Unit-00!」

34:t_022:4.en:
$$ミサト$$
「We've been had! Now that its pattern is no longer an Angel's, $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ HQ won't self-destruct even if it invades $$セントラルドグマ$$!」

34:t_023:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「All units have launched! The $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ is also standing by in $$相模湾$$!」

34:t_023:1.en:
$$マリ$$
「Heh... Puppy... $c... You're a little late...」

34:t_023:2.en:
$$マリ$$
「That thing... has fused with Unit-00... It absorbed the pilot along with it...」

34:t_023:4.en:
$$シンジ$$
「It's not over... It's not... too late, either...」

34:t_023:6.en:
$$マリ$$
「Heh... I thought you'd be more of a mopey guy... but you're a hothead, Puppy...」

34:t_023:7.en:
$$マリ$$
「But, sorry... Unit-02 is... at its limit...」

34:t_023:8.en:
$$マリ$$
「I'll leave the rest to you... $$碇シンジ$$...」

34:t_024:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What's going on?! Are the $$サイデリアル$$ and an Angel attacking $$ＮＥＲＶ$$?!」

34:t_024:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「So this is... what that bad feeling $$千鳥$$ had before we sortied was about...!」

34:t_024:4.en:
$n
「($$千鳥$$ sensed something was wrong, and she came along on the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$...)」

34:t_024:5.en:
$n
「($$千鳥$$'s unease... Is it the same as the premonition inside me...?)」

34:t_024:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You felt it too, $$バナージ$$...!」

34:t_024:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I can feel $$レイ#pt394$$ from that Angel...!」

34:t_024:9.en:
$$オットー$$
「I just got word from Colonel $$葛城$$...! The Angel has fused with $$綾波レイ$$!」

34:t_024:13.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I...! I will absolutely rescue $$綾波$$!」

34:t_024:15.en:
$$アルト$$
「We'll back you up! You go after the Angel!」

34:t_024:16.en:
$$オズマ$$
「All units, don't let the $$サイデリアル$$ near Unit-01! We'll deal with them!」

34:t_024:17.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Unit-01 isn't connected to a cable! Its operating time is estimated at 5 minutes!」

34:t_024:18.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Then we'll take down the Angel in those 5 minutes!」

34:t_024:20.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「That comes after! If we don't stop the Angel, nothing can be done!」

34:t_024:21.en:
$$ボビー$$
「I'm counting on you, $$シンジ$$-chan! We'll kick those pests out of your way!」

34:t_024:23.en:
$n
「The $$サイデリアル$$ general we met on the Central Asian front...!」

34:t_024:24.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「This is our chance, General! Let them fight that monster, and when they're worn out...」

34:t_024:27.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「They are warriors. Against such opponents, petty tactics are unnecessary...!」

34:t_024:28.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Let's go, $c! I will bury that monster and the artificial humans alike!」

34:t_024:29.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「And we will dedicate that victory to Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$!」

34:t_024:30.en:
$$オズマ$$
「All units, be careful! The $$サイデリアル$$ aren't just after us, they're going after the Angel too!」

34:t_024:31.en:
$$アムロ$$
「They intend to take down the Angel along with $$レイ#pt394$$! Stop them, and rescue $$レイ#pt394$$ at the same time!」

34:t_024:33.en:
$$シンジ$$
「$$綾波$$!! I'm coming right now!!」

34:t_026:1.en:
$$ミサト$$
「No, $$シンジ$$! The EVA is already...!」

34:t_028:1.en:
$$マヤ$$
「Unit-01 has reached its operating limit! The backup won't run either!」

34:t_030:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ are coming!」

34:t_031:0.en:
$n
「Get out of the way! If this keeps up, $$シンジ$$ will...!」

34:t_032:0.en:
$$マヤ$$
「It's moving... It should be at its operating limit...」

34:t_032:2.en:
$$リツコ$$
「I don't know... What on earth is happening to Unit-01...」

34:t_033:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's not the EVA we've known until now...! But it isn't a berserk, either!」

34:t_033:3.en:
$$ミサト$$
「To think an EVA has this kind of power...」

34:t_033:4.en:
$$リツコ$$
「Unit-01 has gone beyond the realm of humans...」

34:t_033:5.en:
$$マヤ$$
「Plug depth is over 180! It's too dangerous now!」

34:t_033:6.en:
$$リツコ$$
「Stop, $$シンジ$$! You won't be able to go back to being human!」

葛城.evidence: Otto says 葛城一佐 (Colonel Katsuragi); surname of Misato Katsuragi (glossary 葛城ミサト, female), the NERV officer who contacted the ship; no bare 葛城 entry in the sheet

uncertain: ワンコ君 (34:t_023:1, :6) rendered 'Pup'; no settled rendering yet, check against dlg_2005_01/02
34:t_021:2 and other Rei rows: speaker token レイ#pt394 (Rei, female) chosen; in-speech レイ (Amuro/Monica/$n) also $$レイ#pt394$$
葛城一佐 rendered 'Colonel $$葛城$$' (new name token); 一佐 = Colonel as for other JSDF-style ranks

人造人間 (Dabalan, 34:t_024:28) = 'artificial humans' (taken to mean the EVAs); 'Angel' for bare 使徒, 'Unit-00/01/02' for 零号機/初号機/２号機
